title: Vantage simulator rig (sim_rig.json), schema vantage.sim_rig/1
description: What a simulator bridge reads: one variant of a Vantage project as a simulator needs it (core/simrig.py; `vantage project.vantage --carla-rig OUT` writes it with sim_remap.npz beside it). Vehicle frame: ISO 8855, x forward, y left, z up, metres, origin at the rear-axle centre on the ground. Orientations: intrinsic Z-Y-X yaw, pitch, roll in degrees, pitch positive DOWN. Blocks named 'carla' and 'blueprint', and the views/atlas/remap of a camera, are CARLA's encoding of the same rig. docs/simulator-bridge.md explains every field and what a bridge must write back. The schema is strict (an unknown key is an error) so that it documents every field Vantage writes; the CARLA bridge reads the file tolerantly.

schema.description: Marks the file and its version.

carla_version.description: The CARLA release the CARLA-specific blocks were planned for ('0.9.16').

variant_uid.description: The variant's uid in the project.

created.description: When the file was written: ISO 8601 UTC, seconds.

faults.description: Faults to inject, with known answers (the same list faults.json holds).

tf_static.description: The static transforms the bag's /tf_static carries.

assumptions.description: What the CARLA run assumes, in prose (copied into dataset.json and README.md).

notes.description: What planning the rig found worth saying (rates rounded to the step, lidar resampling, render cost).

provenance.description: Added by a batch run (core/provenance.py, schema vantage.provenance/1); the bridge ignores it.

pose.description: A mount in the vehicle frame: position of the optical centre (a GNSS antenna's phase centre, an IMU's axis origin), metres; yaw, pitch, roll degrees (intrinsic Z-Y-X, pitch positive down). The sensor's own frame is x forward, y left, z up (REP 103); a camera's optical frame is BODY_TO_OPTICAL · Rᵀ.

carla_pose.description: CARLA only: the mount relative to the ego origin in CARLA's left-handed axes (location (x, −y, z)) and a carla.Rotation in degrees (pitch = −pitch, yaw = −yaw, roll = roll for a plain pose).

vehicle.description: The ego vehicle: the project's dimensions and the CARLA vehicle nearest them.

blueprint.description: CARLA only: the ego's blueprint id.

how.description: How it was chosen: 'chosen', 'nearest by size', or no body ('a typical small car').

project.description: The project body's length, width, height, wheelbase (m), lower-case keys; empty without a body.

candidates.description: CARLA only: the four nearest blueprints and their scores (mean relative size difference).

carla.description: CARLA only: the chosen blueprint's measured box (m): null for a blueprint not in Vantage's table.

rear_axle_x.description: The rear axle's x in the actor frame (m).

size_error.description: The chosen vehicle's mean relative size difference from the project's body.

measured.description: The project body measured in the vehicle frame (m): Length, Width, Height, Wheelbase, front_x, rear_x.

tick_hz.description: Simulation steps per second; every planned stamp is a whole number of steps from the sync pulse.

warmup_ticks.description: Steps run with the sensors attached before t = 0: a whole number of lidar rotations, at least 3 and one camera period.

bridge_memory_gb.description: CARLA only: the bridge's estimated peak memory.

render_mpx_per_frame.description: CARLA only: megapixels rendered per frame of all cameras (images and ground truth).

lidar_period_s.description: The sync plan's period (the reference lidar's rotation), null without a lidar.

readout_s.description: The cameras' readout time in the sync plan.

exposure_s.description: The cameras' exposure time in the sync plan.

weather.description: The weather setting: 'project', 'vantage:<id>' or a CARLA preset (the mapped values are in 'weather').

seed.description: Seeds the spawn choices, the traffic and every random choice of the run.

warmup_s.description: Seconds of traffic before the sensors are attached.

params.description: The scenario's parameters that were set (the rest take their defaults).

traffic_source.description: SUMO traffic (CARLA): present only when Eclipse SUMO drives the other vehicles, co-simulated in lockstep with the simulator (vantage/sim/sumo_cosim.py); absent, the simulator's own traffic (CARLA's traffic manager) drives them.

vehicles.description: Vehicles in the network at once (a free drive's traffic, a scenario's Other traffic; 0: SUMO is not started).

net.description: auto (CARLA's bundled net for Town01, Town04, Town05, else one generated from the map's OpenDRIVE), generate, or the path of a .net.xml or .sumocfg.

demand.description: count: vehicles at once; period: one inserted every period_s.

classes.description: SUMO vehicle classes drawn (CARLA's vtypes.json maps them to blueprints).

binary.description: auto (SUMO_HOME/bin/sumo of CARLA's Python's sumo package) or a path.

net_kind.description: What the net will be for the rig's town.

step_s.description: SUMO's step: the simulation step, or the fewest whole simulation steps that are whole milliseconds (SUMO's clock).

semantic.description: Semantic label images per camera frame.

instance.description: Instance images and the objects per camera frame.

lidar_labels.description: nuScenes-lidarseg and -panoptic labels per lidar sweep.

camera_kinds.description: CARLA only: the label cameras rendered beside every view.

fault.description: A fault with a known answer (carla_bridge.FAULT_KINDS). rotation: deg [yaw, pitch, roll] in the sensor's own frame (R_actual = R_plan · R(deg)); translation: m [x, y, z] in the vehicle frame; clock_offset: ms (data captured at t stamped t + ms); drop: rate (0-0.9, seeded) or frames [k, ...]; freeze: from_s, to_s (frames stamped in [from, to) repeat the last one before); range_bias: m along every lidar or radar ray.

m.description: translation: [x, y, z] m; range_bias: m.

items.description: An actors scene: the ego stands still with these around it, no traffic (the same list actors.json holds).

id.description: Unique in the scene (a critical target's uid).

kind.description: child, pedestrian, cyclist, car, truck, traffic_light, sign, cone, barrier, or blueprint:<id> (CARLA only).

pose.description: Vehicle frame: x, y the box's ground-contact centre, z its lowest point (m), yaw its heading (degrees, counter-clockwise from +x).

spawn_point.description: CARLA only: the ego's spawn point; −1: a straight road chosen by the seed.

server.description: CARLA only: the server the run talks to.

source.description: A CARLA preset, or a Vantage weather condition mapped onto CARLA's parameters.

condition.description: The Vantage condition's id (source vantage only).

preset.description: The CARLA preset; empty for a mapped condition.

params.description: CARLA's WeatherParameters for a mapped condition (empty for a preset): cloudiness, precipitation, precipitation_deposits, wind_intensity, wetness, fog_density 0-100; sun_azimuth_angle, sun_altitude_angle degrees; fog_distance m; fog_falloff.

image_scale.description: Images are this share of the sensor's size (cameras[].image has the result).

channel_names.description: tags: CAM_<TAG>, LIDAR_<TAG>, RADAR_<TAG>; nuscenes: CAM_FRONT, LIDAR_TOP … (the channels in cameras[].channel are already the chosen ones).

keyframe_hz.description: nuScenes samples per second asked for.

keyframe_ref_hz.description: The rate of the stream keyframes are taken from (the first lidar's, else the first camera's).

lidar_noise_cm.description: Range noise (1 sigma) along each lidar ray.

drop_self_hits.description: Drop lidar points inside the ego's own box.

camera_rate.description: lidar: one frame per lidar rotation at the sync plan's trigger; module: the module's frame rate.

undistort.description: Rectified pinhole images instead of the real lens's.

exposure.description: CARLA only: manual (every view of a camera alike) or CARLA's auto exposure.

gt_range_m.description: Actors are annotated within this horizontal distance of the ego.

epoch_us.description: t = 0 of the drive (the first sync pulse) in microseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC.

image.description: The image the bridge writes and the calibration the outputs state for it (OpenCV pixel coordinates: centres on integers).

K.description: 3x3 camera matrix at the image's size.

distortion_model.description: equidistant: Kannala-Brandt k1..k4 (cv2.fisheye; ROS's name for it); plumb_bob: a pinhole (all zero).

sensor_size.description: The module's sensor in pixels [width, height].

max_theta_deg.description: The lens's field: the largest angle off the axis that reaches the image.

anyOf.description: The real lens: an optical-frame ray at angle θ off the axis lands at image height r(θ) from (cx, cy) in the sensor's pixel-edge coordinates (pixel i covers [i, i+1)), y scaled by aspect; scaled by image_size / sensor_size into the image. Rays beyond max_theta_deg see nothing (black).

projection.description: r(θ) = f tan θ, f θ, 2f sin(θ/2), 2f tan(θ/2), f sin θ, or f θ (1 + k1 θ² + k2 θ⁴ + k3 θ⁶ + k4 θ⁸).

anyOf.description: Rectified images (output.undistort with a non-rectilinear lens): a pinhole with K (OpenCV coordinates) at the image's size, up to max_theta_deg (at most 89°).

tag.description: The camera's tag in the project (F, ML …).

safe_tag.description: The tag as file names and frame ids use it.

channel.description: Its nuScenes channel (CAM_<TAG> or a nuScenes name).

topic.description: Its bag topic prefix: /<tag in lower case>.

views.description: The pinhole views the image is remapped from (one, or the cube faces it needs), all from the camera's optical centre.

f_px.description: Focal length, px; principal point at the view's centre (W/2 − 0.5 in OpenCV coordinates).

fov_deg.description: Horizontal field over the full width: 2 atan(W / 2f).

optical.description: Columns: the view's optical x, y, z in the camera's optical frame.

atlas.description: The views stacked vertically into one image: view k's rows start at offsets[k], its columns at 0.

remap.description: Names of the arrays in sim_remap.npz: x, y float32 (height, width) where each image pixel reads in the atlas (−1: outside the lens's field); blend (cameras of more than one view): the seam feathering's idx, x, y, w.

seam_blend_deg.description: Width of the band across each seam the faces are feathered over.

capture.description: When the camera's frames are taken: tick phase_ticks + k · every_ticks from the sync pulse.

exposure_centre_s.description: The sync plan's exposure centre after the sync pulse.

recorded_centre_s.description: That centre rounded to a step (the frames' stamps are k / recorded_hz from here).

triggered.description: The sync plan triggers the camera.

trigger_ms.description: The planned trigger after the sync pulse, ms.

render_mpx.description: CARLA only: megapixels of its views.

gt_render_mpx.description: CARLA only: megapixels of its ground-truth views.

carla.description: CARLA only: the mount turned by mount_turn_deg about its z.

mount_turn_deg.description: The turn about z that puts CARLA's start direction (backwards) on the planned phase: phase = 180 + mount_turn_deg (360° lidars; 0 otherwise).

blueprint.description: CARLA only: sensor.lidar.ray_cast attributes. channels evenly spaced from upper_fov (channel 0) to lower_fov, degrees; range m; horizontal_fov degrees; rotation_frequency Hz.

keep.description: Per blueprint channel the ring it records (ring 0 the lowest beam), −1 dropped.

elevation_error_deg.description: The largest beam elevation error of the channel grid (0: exact).

oversample.description: CARLA only: the azimuth cast this many times finer and thinned back.

steps_per_rotation.description: Simulation steps per rotation: tick_hz / rate_hz.

rotation.description: The model's direction, seen from above (CARLA's lidar always turns clockwise).

items.description: A detection zone: a rectangle in azimuth × elevation (degrees from the radar's axis; elevation from its horizontal plane) up to range m.

inside_share.description: CARLA only: the share of the cone's rays inside the rectangle.

blueprint.description: CARLA only: sensor.other.radar attributes of the cone that holds the zone.

channel.description: Not a nuScenes sensor: bag only.

antennas.description: A GNSS/INS's antennas (0: an IMU alone, no orientation).

noise.description: accel_sigma m/s², gyro_sigma rad/s (white, per sample), accel_bias m/s², gyro_bias rad/s (constant, drawn per run).

channel.description: Not a nuScenes sensor: bag only.

sigma_h_m.description: Horizontal position noise (1 sigma), m; the vertical is twice it.

blueprint.description: CARLA only: sensor.other.gnss noise in degrees (lat, lon) and metres (alt).

nuscenes.description: Rows the bridge copies into its nuScenes tables (for the channels it writes).

items.description: The PLAN's calibration (a fault never changes it). p_ego = R(rotation) · p_sensor + translation; a camera's frame is its optical frame.

camera_intrinsic.description: 3x3 at the image's size (cameras); empty for lidars and radars.

rectified_from.description: With rectified images: the lens they were rectified from.

categories.description: [name, description] of the nuScenes categories the drive may use.

visibility.description: [token, level, description] of nuScenes' four visibility bins.
